bio: Tabkeaw is a perennial favourite that captivates diners of all ages. With its bamboo panelling, pagoda bar and traditional figurines, the entrance makes for an immersive experience. Plus, you get the lively atmosphere of the Wyck neighbourhood thrown in for free. The food is just as authentic as the decor: aromatic, delicately walking the line between sweet and sour, spicy but never overwhelmingly so – think beef strips with al dente vegetables, sticky rice and a delicate green curry and coconut sauce. A culinary adventure!...
